injection_strategy: Swapped the if/else branches for CSV writer construction inside stream_fn. In the correct code, EscapeHtmlWriter wraps the writer only in trace mode (HTML debug view). The bug applies EscapeHtmlWriter in the normal (non-trace) branch instead, causing regular CSV downloads to HTML-encode characters like & < > ' ".
expected_failure_summary: Normal CSV downloads have HTML entity encoding: & becomes &, < becomes < etc. The trace=html debug mode is now unescaped (correct values but wrong context). Any test checking raw CSV values with these characters will fail.
calibration_notes: Medium difficulty: model must find the inverted if/else block around EscapeHtmlWriter. The fix is a direct swap of two lines.
